limitations: Four development training seeds, no heldout; S13 zero-shot.
Separate runners do not reproduce all retraining outcomes exactly, even in matched zero controls; cross-capacity differences are not an isolated causal effect.
Context selector is a fixed observation-only heuristic, not LearnedRelevance.
Initial-event corruption has no effect when absent/evicted/visible; other cue events and recurrent state remain.
Original frozen checkpoints reproduced per-seed original success exactly; retraining is not claimed bitwise reproducible.
